Package org.zvec.binding

Class Doc

java.lang.Object
org.zvec.binding.Doc
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class Doc extends Object implements AutoCloseable
High-level wrapper for zvec_doc_t.

Documents are the fundamental unit of data. Each document has a primary key and a set of typed fields. Use the typed add/get methods for convenient access.

After close() every operation on this object throws a ZvecException with ErrorCode.FAILED_PRECONDITION. The C API treats a NULL document as a no-op, so without this guard a document reused after being closed would silently discard writes instead of failing.
